title: The Moss-Grown Guardian
summary: An interactive Three.js overgrown conservatory where a weathered mechanical guardian wakes to a blue morpho butterfly and releases dandelion seeds.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 habitat and 30-second short film. Inside an abandoned glass conservatory, a weathered moss-draped guardian awakens to a blue morpho butterfly, opens its amber eye, and releases drifting dandelion seeds from a living clockwork terrarium.
